_doc: Roles M6 setup creates (28 section 8.1). Kibana privileges confirmed by a probe (2026-11-12): a key with these ran POST /api/workflows/workflow/<id>/run past the privilege check (the earlier feature_workflows.* names gave 403, workflowsManagement:execute). Probe r5 (2026-11-12) confirmed the rest: under this key the workflow's ai.agent step ran to completion and its structured_output.proposals fed a foreach that wrote documents. Index privileges are the design: read the trace stream and the run records, create documents in cortex-eval-proposals, nothing else. Probe r4: the evaluator workflow's ai.agent step failed under this key with cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get unauthorized, so the role carries the cluster privilege monitor_inference; r5 re-ran under the key with it (completed) and without it (failed with the same error).
